title.en: American football coach: from listing to the people who find you
title.af: Amerikaanse voetbalafrigter: van advertensie tot die mense wat jou vind
title.zu: Umqeqeshi webhola laseMelika: kusukela esikhangisweni kuya kubazali abakutholayo
title.xh: Umqeqeshi webhola yaseMelika: ukusuka kwintengiso ukuya kubazali abakufumanayo
title.nso: Mohlahli wa kgwele ya Amerika: go tloga papatšong go ya go batswadi bao ba go hwetšago

chapters.nso: Baithuti ba gago ba ka mehla

en: Open Quick, go to [[Tutors]] and tap [[Offer tutoring]]
Swipe the doors until you see Tutors. One tap starts your listing.
af: Maak Quick oop, gaan na [[Tutors]] en tik [[Offer tutoring]]
Swiep deur die deure tot jy Tutors sien. Een tik begin jou advertensie.
zu: Vula i-Quick, iya ku-[[Tutors]] bese uthepha [[Offer tutoring]]
Swayipha iminyango uze ubone i-Tutors. Ukuthepha kanye kuqala isikhangiso sakho.
xh: Vula i-Quick, yiya kwi-[[Tutors]] uze ucofe [[Offer tutoring]]
Tyibilikisa iingcango ude ubone i-Tutors. Ukucofa kanye kuqalisa intengiso yakho.
nso: Bula Quick, eya go [[Tutors]] gomme o kgotle [[Offer tutoring]]
Šuthiša mabati go fihlela o bona Tutors. Go kgotla gatee go thoma papatšo ya gago.

en: Tap [[Sport & fitness]], then your sport
Pick [[Team sports]], then [[American football coach]]. Coach something else? Tap [[Another option]] and type it.
af: Tik [[Sport & fitness]], dan jou sport
Kies [[Team sports]], dan [[American football coach]]. Rig jy iets anders af? Tik [[Another option]] en tik dit in.

en: Set your price per session
Quick opens on [[Per session]]: type what one session costs. [[Per month]] and [[Per package]] are one tap away. Coaching is priced for the session, so there is no minimum-wage floor.
af: Stel jou prys per sessie
Quick begin by [[Per session]]: tik wat een sessie kos. [[Per month]] en [[Per package]] is een tik weg. Afrigting word per sessie geprys, so daar is geen minimumloon-vloer nie.

en: Tick the areas where you train people
You can tick more than one; anyone searching any of them finds you.
af: Merk die gebiede waar jy mense afrig
Jy kan meer as een merk; enigiemand wat in enige van hulle soek, vind jou.

en: Check your listing, then save
Your sport, your price and your areas are on it. Add your first name and email and tap [[Save my listing]].
af: Kyk na jou advertensie en stoor dit
Jou sport, jou prys en jou gebiede is daarop. Voeg jou voornaam en e-pos by en tik [[Save my listing]].

en: Saved: now sign the terms and publish
Tap [[Sign the terms and publish]], or open the email we sent you. Nobody can see your listing yet.
af: Gestoor: teken nou die bepalings en publiseer
Tik [[Sign the terms and publish]], of maak die e-pos oop wat ons gestuur het. Niemand kan jou advertensie nog sien nie.
zu: Kulondoloziwe: manje sayina imigomo bese ushicilela
Thepha [[Sign the terms and publish]], noma uvule i-imeyili esikuthumelele yona. Akekho umuntu ongabona isikhangiso sakho okwamanje.
xh: Kugciniwe: ngoku sayina imimiselo uze upapashe
Cofa [[Sign the terms and publish]], okanye uvule i-imeyile esikuthumelele yona. Akukho mntu unokubona intengiso yakho okwangoku.
nso: E bolokilwe: bjale saena melawana gomme o phatlalatše
Kgotla [[Sign the terms and publish]], goba o bule imeile ye re go rometšego yona. Ga go yo a ka bonago papatšo ya gago ga bjale.

en: Add photos of where you train people
In TrustSquare tap [[Edit]], then [[Add Photo]]: the field, court, pool or gym and your equipment, no children's faces. Then tap [[Save Changes]] to keep them.
af: Voeg foto's by van waar jy mense afrig
Tik in TrustSquare [[Edit]], dan [[Add Photo]]: die veld, baan, swembad of gimnasium en jou toerusting, geen kinders se gesigte nie. Tik dan [[Save Changes]] om hulle te hou.

en: Accept the seller terms once
Read them, tick both boxes at the end and tap [[I accept]].
af: Aanvaar die verkopersbepalings een keer
Lees hulle, merk albei blokkies aan die einde en tik [[I accept]].
zu: Yamukela imigomo yabathengisi kanye
Yifunde, maka omabili amabhokisi ekugcineni bese uthepha [[I accept]].
xh: Yamkela imimiselo yabathengisi kanye
Yifunde, phawula zombini iibhokisi ekugqibeleni uze ucofe [[I accept]].
nso: Amogela melawana ya barekiši gatee
E bale, swaya mapokisi a mabedi mafelelong gomme o kgotle [[I accept]].

en: Publish: parents can find you at once
Tap [[Publish]]. Your card shows [[Live]].
af: Publiseer: ouers kan jou dadelik vind
Tik [[Publish]]. Jou kaart wys [[Live]].
zu: Shicilela: abazali bangakuthola ngokushesha
Thepha [[Publish]]. Ikhadi lakho likhombisa [[Live]].
xh: Papasha: abazali banokukufumana kwangoko
Cofa [[Publish]]. Ikhadi lakho libonisa [[Live]].
nso: Phatlalatša: batswadi ba ka go hwetša gona bjale
Kgotla [[Publish]]. Karata ya gago e bontšha [[Live]].

en: Tap [[Upload my police clearance]]
It opens the right upload with [[Police clearance]] already chosen. Tap [[Choose file]], pick a clear photo or PDF of your SAPS clearance and tap [[Upload Document]].
af: Tik [[Upload my police clearance]]
Dit maak die regte oplaai oop met [[Police clearance]] reeds gekies. Tik [[Choose file]], kies 'n duidelike foto of PDF van jou SAPD-klaring en tik [[Upload Document]].
zu: Thepha [[Upload my police clearance]]
Ivula indawo efanele yokulayisha, i-[[Police clearance]] isivele ikhethiwe. Thepha [[Choose file]], khetha isithombe esicacile noma i-PDF yesitifiketi sakho se-SAPS bese uthepha [[Upload Document]].
xh: Cofa [[Upload my police clearance]]

Ivula indawo efanelekileyo yokulayisha, i-[[Police clearance]] sele ikhethiwe. Cofa [[Choose file]], khetha umfanekiso ocacileyo okanye i-PDF yesatifikethi sakho se-SAPS uze ucofe [[Upload Document]].
nso: Kgotla [[Upload my police clearance]]

E bula lefelo le le nepagetšego la go romela, [[Police clearance]] e šetše e kgethilwe. Kgotla [[Choose file]], kgetha seswantšho se se kwagalago goba PDF ya setifikeiti sa gago sa SAPS gomme o kgotle [[Upload Document]].

en: Send your Buzz link to the people you already train
In [[My Space]], open [[Buzz]] and tap [[Get my link]]. One link for all of them: [[Send on WhatsApp]] or [[Copy]].
af: Stuur jou Buzz-skakel aan die mense wat jy reeds afrig
Maak [[Buzz]] in [[My Space]] oop en tik [[Get my link]]. Een skakel vir almal: [[Send on WhatsApp]] of [[Copy]].

en: A regular student's parent joins
She opens your link, ticks the Buzz terms and taps [[Continue]]. Now you can buzz each other.
af: Die ouer van 'n vaste leerder sluit aan
Sy maak jou skakel oop, merk die Buzz-bepalings en tik [[Continue]]. Nou kan julle mekaar buzz.
zu: Umzali womfundi ojwayelekile uyajoyina
Uvula isixhumanisi sakho, amake imigomo ye-Buzz bese ethepha [[Continue]]. Manje ningathumelelana nge-Buzz.
xh: Umzali womfundi oqhelekileyo uyajoyina
Uvula ikhonkco lakho, aphawule imimiselo ye-Buzz aze acofe [[Continue]]. Ngoku ningathumelelana nge-Buzz.
nso: Motswadi wa moithuti wa ka mehla o a tsena
O bula kgokagano ya gago, a swaye melawana ya Buzz gomme a kgotle [[Continue]]. Bjale le ka romelana ka Buzz.

en: She buzzes you about a lesson
One line, straight to your phone: "Can we move Thursday's lesson to 5pm?" If your phone has no push, it comes by email.
af: Sy buzz vir jou oor 'n les
Een reël, reguit na jou foon: "Kan ons Donderdag se les na 17:00 skuif?" As jou foon nie kennisgewings kry nie, kom dit per e-pos.
zu: Ukuthumelela nge-Buzz mayelana nesifundo
Umugqa owodwa, uqonde ocingweni lwakho: "Singasusa isifundo sangoLwesine siye ku-5 ntambama?" Uma ucingo lwakho lungenazo izaziso, kufika nge-imeyili.
xh: Ukuthumelela nge-Buzz malunga nesifundo
Umgca omnye, ngqo kwifowuni yakho: "Singasifudusela isifundo sangoLwesine ku-5 emva kwemini?" Ukuba ifowuni yakho ayinazo izaziso, iza nge-imeyile.
nso: O go romela Buzz ka ga thuto
Mothalo o tee, thwii mogaleng wa gago: "Re ka šuthišetša thuto ya Labone go 5 mathapama?" Ge mogala wa gago o se na ditsebišo, e tla ka imeile.

en: Someone new taps [[Find a tutor]], then [[Sport & fitness]]
Then [[Team sports]] and [[American football coach]]: only coaches of that sport are shown.
af: Iemand nuut tik [[Find a tutor]], dan [[Sport & fitness]]
Dan [[Team sports]] en [[American football coach]]: net afrigters van daardie sport word gewys.

en: Then her area: she finds you
Your listing shows with your rate and trust score, next to examples of what a listing looks like.
af: Dan haar area: sy vind jou
Jou advertensie verskyn met jou tarief en vertrouetelling, langs voorbeelde van hoe 'n advertensie lyk.
zu: Bese kuba indawo yakhe: uyakuthola
Isikhangiso sakho sivela nemali yakho namaphuzu okwethenjwa, eduze nezibonelo zokuthi isikhangiso sibukeka kanjani.
xh: Emva koko ummandla wakhe: uyakufumana
Intengiso yakho ivela nexabiso lakho namanqaku okuthenjwa, ecaleni kwemizekelo yokuba intengiso ijongeka njani.
nso: Ke moka lefelo la gagwe: o a go hwetša
Papatšo ya gago e tšwelela le tefo ya gago le dintlha tša go botwa, kgauswi le mehlala ya ka mo papatšo e lebelelwago ka gona.

en: She sees your sport, your price and your trust score
Your photos are at the top, your price under them. Your name and number stay hidden.
af: Sy sien jou sport, jou prys en jou vertrouetelling
Jou foto's is bo, jou prys daaronder. Jou naam en nommer bly versteek.

en: She asks for an introduction
She writes a short message and taps [[Join queue]]. 1 Tuppence is held from her, and spent only if you accept. Asking twice holds nothing more.
af: Sy vra vir 'n bekendstelling
Sy skryf 'n kort boodskap en tik [[Join queue]]. 1 Tuppence word van haar gehou, en net gebruik as jy aanvaar. As sy twee keer vra, word niks meer gehou nie.
zu: Ucela ukwethulwa
Ubhala umlayezo omfushane bese ethepha [[Join queue]]. I-Tuppence engu-1 iyabanjwa kuye, isetshenziswe kuphela uma wamukela. Ukucela kabili akubambi lutho olunye.
xh: Ucela ukwaziswa
Ubhala umyalezo omfutshane aze acofe [[Join queue]]. I-Tuppence e-1 iyabanjwa kuye, isetyenziswe kuphela ukuba uyamkela. Ukucela kabini akubambi nto yimbi.
nso: O kgopela go tsebišwa
O ngwala molaetša o mokopana gomme a kgotla [[Join queue]]. Tuppence e 1 e swarwa go yena, gomme e šomišwa feela ge o amogela. Go kgopela gabedi ga go swere selo se sengwe.

en: You see her request
Open [[Seller Hub]]. Her message is on your listing's card.
af: Jy sien haar versoek
Maak [[Seller Hub]] oop. Haar boodskap is op jou advertensie se kaart.
zu: Ubona isicelo sakhe
Vula i-[[Seller Hub]]. Umlayezo wakhe usekhadini lesikhangiso sakho.
xh: Ubona isicelo sakhe
Vula i-[[Seller Hub]]. Umyalezo wakhe usekhadini lentengiso yakho.
nso: O bona kgopelo ya gagwe
Bula [[Seller Hub]]. Molaetša wa gagwe o karateng ya papatšo ya gago.

en: You accept
Tap [[Accept]]. It costs you nothing. You both get an email: reply to it to talk. Your email address stays private.
af: Jy aanvaar
Tik [[Accept]]. Dit kos jou niks. Julle kry albei 'n e-pos: antwoord daarop om te praat. Jou e-posadres bly privaat.
zu: Uyamukela
Thepha [[Accept]]. Akukubizi lutho. Nobabili nithola i-imeyili: phendula kuyo ukuze nikhulume. Ikheli lakho le-imeyili lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Uyamkela
Cofa [[Accept]]. Akukuxabisi nto. Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile: phendula kuyo ukuze nithethe. Idilesi yakho ye-imeyile ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: O a amogela
Kgotla [[Accept]]. Ga go go biditše selo. Le hwetša imeile ka bobedi: e arabe gore le boledišane. Aterese ya gago ya imeile e dula e le sephiri.

en: She is introduced
In her [[My Space]], [[Intros]] shows [[Accepted]] and her 1 Tuppence is spent. After the first lesson she can tap [[I hired them]].
af: Sy is voorgestel
In haar [[My Space]] wys [[Intros]] [[Accepted]] en haar 1 Tuppence is gebruik. Ná die eerste les kan sy [[I hired them]] tik.
zu: Useyethuliwe
Ku-[[My Space]] yakhe, [[Intros]] ikhombisa [[Accepted]] futhi i-Tuppence yakhe engu-1 isisetshenzisiwe. Ngemva komsebenzi angathepha [[I hired them]].
xh: Sele eziswe
Kwi-[[My Space]] yakhe, [[Intros]] ibonisa [[Accepted]] kwaye i-Tuppence yakhe e-1 isetyenzisiwe. Emva komsebenzi angacofa [[I hired them]].
nso: O tsebišitšwe
Go [[My Space]] ya gagwe, [[Intros]] e bontšha [[Accepted]] gomme Tuppence ya gagwe e 1 e šomišitšwe. Ka morago ga mošomo a ka kgotla [[I hired them]].

en: Pass Quick on
Tap [[Pass Quick on to someone]] and share it with a friend who coaches too.
af: Gee Quick aan
Tik [[Pass Quick on to someone]] en deel dit met 'n vriend wat ook afrig.

gate_note.en: Coming up at step 10: until our team has checked your police clearance, only people you send your link to can see your listing.
gate_note.af: By stap 10: totdat ons span jou polisieklaring nagegaan het, kan net mense aan wie jy jou skakel stuur jou advertensie sien.
gate_note.zu: Kuyeza esinyathelweni 10: kuze kube yilapho ithimba lethu selihlolile isitifiketi sakho samaphoyisa, ngabantu kuphela obathumelela isixhumanisi sakho abangabona isikhangiso sakho.
gate_note.xh: Kwinyathelo le-10: de iqela lethu lihlole isatifikethi sakho samapolisa, ngabantu kuphela obathumelela ikhonkco lakho abanokubona intengiso yakho.
gate_note.nso: Kgatong ya 10: go fihlela sehlopha sa rena se hlahlobile setifikeiti sa gago sa maphodisa, ke batho feela bao o ba romelago kgokagano ya gago bao ba ka bonago papatšo ya gago.
